text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Phew...!
choice_data_list: Alright, that's it for today! Great work!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You as well. 
By the way, if I recall correctly, 
tomorrow is a rest day... Is that right?
choice_data_list: Huh? Oh... yeah, it is.
Huh? Yeah... it is.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good. Then I shall oversee your training 
in the mountains. 
After breakfast, meet me at the entrance 
in comfortable clothes.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It has been a while since I thoroughly 
disciplined you. 
Or would you prefer to leisurely rest at 
the lodge?
choice_data_list: I'm going! Of course I am...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, of course. 
I expected... that you would give such an 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Daily devotion. Without slacking since 
then, they continue learning with earnest 
honesty. 
All in order to walk this distant road 
alongside me.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(We are still only midway down our path. I 
cannot fully reward them yet. 
And yet, I must answer such efforts in 
some form.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it. 
It shall prove fruitful.
choice_data_list:
Right! I'll learn as much as I possibly 
can!

Yeah! I'll learn as much as I possibly 
can!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Apply yourself fully.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next morning.
choice_data_list:
Good morning, Phalaeno. I'm ready to head 
out whenever.

Good morning, Phalaeno. I'm ready to head 
out whenever you are.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mm. 
Truly brimming with spirit, aren't you?
choice_data_list:
It's been a while since I had a full day 
to use, so I got a bit eager.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, how endearing. 
First, however, is breakfast. You won't 
last without eating properly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An hour after stepping onto the mountain 
trail. 
The only sounds around them were bird 
calls and rustling foliage.
choice_data_list: Could today's training just be... hiking?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Whether it proves to be so 
delightful an outing 
depends on your perspective, but...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come tomorrow, your body will be screaming 
with muscle aches.
choice_data_list:
...Which means the real test is still to 
come, huh?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. 
Steel yourself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The wet rocks are slick. 
Watch your step.
choice_data_list:
Stream climbing is... pretty tough once 
you actually try it.

Stream climbing is... really tough once 
you actually try it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Walking through nature reminds one 
anew... 
that paths are seldom flat.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Does it not seem just like the journey 
toward our dream?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There are animal trails, and rivers to 
cross. 
Never from here on will there be an easy, 
paved path.
choice_data_list:
All the more reason I can't let myself 
tire out here.

All the more reason I can't afford to tire 
out here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Just so.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...What is the matter? 
You have been staring straight ahead for 
some time now.
choice_data_list:
I thought it'd be better not to look 
down... Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gripped by tension, I momentarily lost my 
balance 
and instinctively dropped to one knee.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Are you unharmed? 
Be careful, or you will lose your footing.
choice_data_list: T-Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
People often say not to look down... but 
in a situation like this, the reverse is 
true. 
Rather, it is best to keep your eyes on 
your footing.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledge your fear, yet never avert 
your gaze. Not if you wish to overcome it. 
So long as your footing is sure, though 
your pace be slow, you shall never stray.
choice_data_list:
...Even if it's slow, keep moving 
forward... huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I took each step forward, I wondered if 
Phalaenopsis 
meant what she had just said to mirror the 
journey toward our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time we crossed the suspension 
bridge and reached the foot of the cliff, 
fatigue 
had firmly set in. My calves and thighs 
were swollen and aching.
choice_data_list: *Pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis, who had already scaled the 
cliff ahead, came back down.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Can you stand? 
It seems this cliff was still too much for 
you after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment. 
I shall pull you up from the ledge above.
choice_data_list:
...I have to overcome at least this much 
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? ...Then prove it to me. 
In honor of your resolve, I shall not lend 
a hand.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Steel yourself. —Our destination is just 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. 
It truly lives up to the rumors—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What lay before us was a sea of flowers 
stretching far into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A carpet of fantastical colors unfolded 
before our eyes, 
the blossoms swaying like ripples across 
the water as a gentle breeze passed 
through.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A natural haven of flowers known only to a 
handful of locals. 
Given the rugged path, it seemed very few 
ever set foot here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: How do you feel?
choice_data_list:
It's so incredible... All I can say is, 
it's just breathtaking...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. 
It is truly a magnificent sight—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, quite some time had 
passed as I lost myself in the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It seems you have taken quite a 
liking to this place.
choice_data_list:
Sorry, I got carried away... Um, let's get 
back to training—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How full of promise, this young and tender 
sprout, 
May it flourish until bowed beneath its 
bloom.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was a waka poem Phalaenopsis had 
recited in the trainer's office some time 
ago. 
I had thought it was a poem of 
encouragement directed at herself, but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You are doing truly well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
All to support me. 
All to become someone worthy of that duty.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Along the arduous road we walk... 
I cannot yet show you the garden of glory 
that awaits at its end.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
So I thought to show you a sight 
second only to that beauty... you see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Someday, I swear I shall show it to 
you. 
The flower of glory... that I shall bring 
to bloom.
choice_data_list: —...port you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list:
I'll support you. Every flower you bring 
to bloom in that garden.

I'll support you. Every blossom you bring 
to bloom in that garden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...... 
Goodness, you truly are something...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes of yours are so steadfast and 
honest. 
Truly—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —what an endearing soul you are.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we took our time on the way 
here. 
We shall quicken our pace on the way back. 
Make sure you keep up.
choice_data_list: P-Please, go easy on me...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... This, too, is training. 
Until our greatest ambition is fulfilled, 
we must never slacken.
